desc: Iteration 1 unified narrative/directing review of Tilly March story arc against bible §4.6/§9.1 and the WP2 clue-slot master.

items.name: Narrative architecture and hard rules
items.evidence: The 12-episode arc keeps Act 1 light, places judgment-error at D5.day registrySquare, resolves at D6.evening, and keeps T3 unconfirmed. Isen is not identified as Tilly's old exam proctor; the explicit non-link guard is inside the EP05 secret block. Banned names are absent.

items.name: Route slot integration
items.evidence: The D5.morning C-06 payload is written as `collate{a: tillyCharm, b: lining}` in story-arc.md, story-arc-act-2.md, and story-arc.json. The WP2 slot master engine contract requires canonical lexical ordering `{a: "lining", b: "tillyCharm"}` for C-06; the current payload can miss the consuming collate guard and prevent `found(liningIsMolt)` from firing.
editInstructions: Replace every C-06 payload occurrence `collate{a: tillyCharm, b: lining}` with `collate{a: lining, b: tillyCharm}` in story-arc.md, story-arc-act-2.md, and story-arc.json; retain the existing D5.morning slot and heart==2 guard.

items.name: Catharsis, POV, and directing coverage
items.evidence: Episodes provide Fixer POV fields, per-episode bridges, tone/voice schedules, CG placement, and the D6.evening weak-end/cleared split. The SoT and its three slices carry the same route and directing decisions.
